aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Asia at 83.89% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Linux ranked second at 6.59%, followed by OS X at 5.32%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Asia?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 83.89% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/asia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in Asia?
faqs.answer: Windows (83.89%), Linux (6.59%), OS X (5.32%) in October 2026.
